name: actions_list
description: A project's actions (the commands its actions.json declares) and their runs.

name: actions_run
description: Run an action to the end and answer with its output.

name.description: The action's name, as actions.list gives it

name: actions_start
description: Start an action that keeps running, such as a dev server; answers with its run.

name.description: The action's name, as actions.list gives it

name: actions_stop
description: Stop an action's run.

run_id.description: The run's id, as actions.start or actions.list gives it

name: agents_list
description: The agents a chat in a project can start with, for chats.start: each one's models, default model, the efforts (reasoning_level) each model accepts, and its modes and permission modes.

name: chats_list
description: List the chats on this environment, newest activity first, filtered and sorted like the chat drawer. Empty cwd is every project.

agent.description: Only this agent's chats: claude, codex; empty is all

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor; empty starts over

cwd.description: A project's folder; empty is every project

parent.description: Only the chats this chat's agent started; empty leaves those out

refresh.description: Re-read the agents' files first; slow, leave false

resolved.description: true: only resolved chats; false: only open ones; omit for both

search.description: Words a chat's title, prompts or replies must all hold

name: chats_info
description: One chat's row: title, project, status, last reply.

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

name: chats_messages
description: A page of one chat's messages. tail with a limit reads the newest; before_index pages older.

before_index.description: Messages before this index, to page older

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

name: chats_send
description: Send a message to a chat. It starts a turn, or queues behind the running one; steer adds it to the running turn where the agent allows it.

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

steer.description: Add it to the running turn instead of queueing it

attachments.description: Files sent with it; usually empty

config.description: Model and modes; empty keeps the chat's own

name: chats_start
description: Start a new chat in a project with its first message. Started by an agent, it runs under the calling chat, out of the drawer, with no broader permissions; child false opens a normal chat for the user instead.

child.description: For an agent: false opens a normal chat for the user; omit to start one under this chat

title.description: The chat's name; empty takes the message's opening words

attachments.description: Files sent with it; usually empty

config.description: Model and modes; empty keeps the chat's own

name: chats_wait
description: Wait for a turn chats.start or chats.send returned to end, then return its state, its chat_id and the agent's last message. A timeout leaves it running; wait again.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait; default 50000, at most 300000

turn_id.description: The turn_id chats.start or chats.send returned

name: chats_resolve
description: Resolve a chat (moves it to the done pile) or unresolve it.

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

name: chats_pin
description: Pin a chat to the top of the drawer, or unpin it.

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

name: chats_update
description: Rename a chat. The title is written to the agent's own files, so its CLI shows it too.

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

name: chats_stop
description: Stop a chat's running turn.

chat_id.description: The chat's id, as chats.list gives it

name: connect_list
description: Whether each target is connected on this environment: an env key (env:NAME with its scope), an MCP server (mcp:<url>) or a CLI's sign-in (cli:<tool>); never with what.

project.description: The project the card or agent is in

scope.description: For an env key, its file: file:<path>, plugin:<name>, plugins or source:<handle>

target.description: What is connected: env:<NAME>, mcp:<url> or cli:<tool>

name: connect_get
description: A connect flow the user was shown: waiting, or how it ended.

flow_id.description: The flow's id, as connect.start gave it

name: git_status
description: Branch, ahead/behind and changed-file counts for several projects at once.

name: git_changes
description: One project's changed files, staged or not.

name: git_diff
description: One project's uncommitted totals: files changed, lines added and removed. git.changes lists the files.

name: limits_read
description: Each agent's plan and how much of each rate-limit window is used, with when it resets.

name: plugins_logs
description: The console lines plugins wrote, newest first, each with the plugin, the method and the call that wrote it, and errors methods threw. Read it when a plugin or a card showing one misbehaves.

level.description: This level and worse: debug, info, warn or error; empty is every level

limit.description: At most this many, newest first; 100 unless said, at most 1000

method.description: Only lines written while this method ran, as <plugin>.<method>

plugin.description: Only this plugin's lines; empty is every plugin

query.description: Only lines whose text contains this

since.description: Only lines at or after this time, in ms since the epoch

until.description: Only lines before this time, in ms since the epoch

name: projects_list
description: The projects on this environment, with each one's folder (the cwd chats take), name, pin and changed files.

name: projects_rename
description: Rename a project, by its folder as projects.list gives it. A blank name clears the rename, back to the repository or folder name.

name: projects_pin
description: Pin a project to the top of the project list, or unpin it.

name: reminders_list
description: The pending reminders on this environment, soonest first.

path.description: Only this project's; every reminder when left out

name: reminders_create
description: Notify the user's phones at a set time; a tap opens this chat. Set one only when the user asks for it or agrees to it.

chat_id.description: The chat a tap on the notification opens; this chat when left out

due_at.description: When, in Unix milliseconds; or give in

in.description: How long from now, such as 45m, 2h or 3d; or give due_at

text.description: What the notification says, up to 200 characters

name: reminders_delete
description: Cancel a pending reminder.

id.description: The reminder's id, as reminders_list gives it

name: schedules_list
description: The scheduled prompts on this environment, with each one's project, agent and next run.

name: tunnels_list
description: The open tunnels: each public URL and the local port it reaches.
